name: sabnzbd
description: Automated Usenet downloader with a browser-based interface

fields.name: SABNZBD_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web UI Port
fields.help: Host port used to open the SABnzbd setup wizard and Web UI.

fields.name: CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R2: Config Folder
fields.help: Host folder for SABnzbd configuration and application state.

fields.name: INCOMPLETE_DOWNLOADS_LOCATION
fields.label: R3: Incomplete Downloads Folder
fields.help: Host folder used while downloads are incomplete or being processed.

fields.name: DOWNLOADS_LOCATION
fields.label: R4: Completed Downloads Folder
fields.help:
Host folder for completed downloads.
For hardlinks or atomic moves with other media applications, plan compatible host paths and filesystems before deployment.

fields.name: PUID
fields.label: R5: PUID
fields.help: Linux user ID used by the container for bind-mounted file permissions.

fields.name: PGID
fields.label: R6: PGID
fields.help: Linux group ID used by the container for bind-mounted file permissions.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: R7: Timezone
fields.help: Timezone used by SABnzbd, such as Asia/Dubai or Etc/UTC.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O1: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: SABNZBD_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O2: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the default Compose network, Host Mode for host networking, or an existing named Docker network.

fields.name: SABNZBD_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: LinuxServer SABnzbd stable image. Change this only if you need a different tag or image source.

fields.name: SABNZBD_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: SABNZBD_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal Web UI Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed SABnzbd Web UI port inside the container.

ui.overview: SABnzbd automates downloading, verification, repair, extraction, and organization of Usenet downloads.
what_happens: One SABnzbd container will be created using the LinuxServer image
Configuration, incomplete downloads, and completed downloads will be stored in the bind-mounted folders you choose
The initial SABnzbd setup wizard will be available on the selected Web UI port
The container will use the selected Docker networking mode
ui.data_location: Each storage field can be relative to this app's config folder or an absolute host path.
